text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: CANARY ALERT v3.4.1 -> hosted (10%): p95 latency +35%, error-rate 2.1x baseline over 5m. Auto-rollback threshold met. Planned action: automatic revert in 2m unless a human 'hold' is posted. Change window remaining: ~30m.

micah: seeing same on dashboards. spikes concentrated on /embed route. before auto-revert, can we confirm it's not a migration or infra flake? I'm running a few curl tests. :eyes:

jia: checked node logs around 1758201300 — repeated "KV cache miss assertion" from model runtime on rtx pools. Not seeing DB migration traffic. seems compatibility issue with kv cache path. recommend manual control, don't let autopilot revert yet.

amanda: if we do rollback we'll need a short release-note addendum and CSM heads-up. I'll draft comms if ops decide to roll.

sonny: ops suggestion: revert to v3.4.0 with reason=canary-spike in 90s using `rollout revert --version v3.4.0 --reason canary-spike --no-confirm`. micah, do you want me to hold or proceed?

micah: hold for now. curl shows 500s only on embeddings route, other routes (chat/generate) look fine. if it's just embeddings we should be able to partial-pin that route instead of full rollback.

jia: we can do route-level split. I'll set embeddings route new=0% in deploy UI/API and watch telemetry. doing it now.

deploy-bot: action taken: traffic-slice update for route=/embed -> new=0% completed at 1758201800. Observability: embeddings error-rate fell ~70% within 30s. p95 reduced.

micah: nice. cancelling auto-rollback. sonny — please abort the revert command. amanda — please notify CSMs and #customers-ops that embeddings are routed back to v3.4.0 and we're monitoring.

amanda: posting to #customers-ops: "Partial routing change: embeddings routed back to v3.4.0 due to canary errors. Monitoring. No customer impact expected beyond degraded new-model embeds. Will update if anything changes."

sonny: manual revert cancelled. we keep canary at 10% overall but embeddings pinned to stable. action items: jia -> hotfix branch for kv cache compatibility, micah -> confirm no further regressions, amanda -> update release notes & comms, sonny -> block autopilot for this rollout until hotfix deploy.

jia: hotfix branch created, PR up with kvcache fix. CI green locally, scheduling a patched canary tomorrow in change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

micah: recap for the thread: autopilot rollback was triggered, humans intervened with route-level split which avoided a full rollback. outcome: partial pin applied; hotfix planned; comms sent. closing unless someone objects. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: alert closed at 1758202420. Auto-rollback suppressed by manual action.
